name: Own-savings standing order then a bill on the same account, 500 spare elsewhere (G426)

expected.notes: G426 (Kevin 2026-11-06). Today Tue 24 Nov 2026, pay period last Friday, so payday is Fri 27 Nov and the window is 24 to 26 Nov. Barclays Current holds 150. Its own-savings standing order of 300 into Barclays Saver (savings, in no pool) is dated Wed 25 Nov, then a Phone bill of 100 on Thu 26 Nov. Walk: 150 - 300 = -150 on the 25th (the order bounces), 150 - 300 - 100 = -250 on the 26th (the Phone bill cascades). After payments and low point are -250, so the verdict is short. Payments alone, with the order left out: 150 - 100 = +50, so the Phone bill would have cleared; none of the -250 is a payment shortfall. Savings part = 250 - 0 = 250 (amber, never red). The cover plan funds the whole walk deficit once: ceil5(250) + 10 cushion = 260. Monzo Current holds 500 with nothing due, headroom 500 - 10 = 490, so one move of 260 from Monzo to Barclays; the saver is never a source. Earmarks: Monzo set aside 260, Spend from 500 - 260 = 240; Barclays Spend from is its 10 cushion (spendable only after the move). Short after cover = max(0, 250 - 260) = 0. At risk count 0: the Phone bill bounces only because the order went first. In the payment-only walk (order left out) 150 - 100 = +50, so it clears; it is savings at risk, not a payment at risk, until the order is skipped. The order itself is a movement and never counts. Left to spend: pool 150 + 500 = 650, minus the 300 order (destination not pooled) and the 100 bill = 250, and 240 + 10 = 250 exactly. Skipping the order this month (an occurrence override) removes the move, the earmark and the savings fact: the Phone bill then clears from 150 and nothing is short. The payday plan is unchanged (null, G402). G438 (Kevin 2026-11-07), which supersedes the savings at risk reading above: the order is an ordinary predicted payment, so the Phone bill that bounces after it is an ordinary payment at risk (no payment-only discount). Walk as before: 150 - 300 = -150 on the 25th (the order is a movement and never counts), 150 - 300 - 100 = -250 on the 26th (Phone bounces and counts). At risk count 1 (was 0). Cover move 260 from Monzo, Spend from, earmarks and Left to spend are unchanged. The savings_at_risk facts are gone.
